summary.text: Tim Fleming is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. A state representative from Covington and a business owner, he previously served as deputy secretary of state under Brian Kemp.

paragraphs.text: Former deputy secretary of state under then-Secretary of State Brian Kemp.
Georgia state representative from Covington, who recently chaired a legislative committee examining Georgia's election policies.
